answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the knoll of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the spiral of the next round.
